+import pytest
+
+from jsonschema.exceptions import ValidationError
+
+
+class SinglePass:
+    def __init__(self, values):
+        self.values = values
+        self.iterations = 0
+
+    def __iter__(self):
+        self.iterations += 1
+        assert self.iterations == 1
+        return iter(self.values)
+
+
+def as_generator(values):
+    yield from values
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("wrap", [list, tuple, iter, as_generator, SinglePass])
+def test_context_iterables_preserve_nested_locations(wrap):
+    leaf = ValidationError(
+        "leaf", path=["bad-name", 1],
+        schema_path=[0, "properties", "bad-name", "items", "type"],
+    )
+    nested = wrap([leaf])
+    child = ValidationError(
+        "child", path=["branch"], schema_path=[0, "oneOf"],
+        context=nested,
+    )
+    sibling = ValidationError(
+        "sibling", path=[4], schema_path=[1, "type"],
+    )
+    children = wrap([child, sibling])
+    root = ValidationError(
+        "root", path=["payload", 2],
+        schema_path=["properties", "payload", "items", "anyOf"],
+        context=children,
+    )
+
+    assert isinstance(root.context, list)
+    assert len(root.context) == 2
+    assert root.context[0] is child
+    assert root.context[1] is sibling
+    assert len(child.context) == 1
+    assert child.context[0] is leaf
+    assert sibling.context == []
+    assert leaf.context == []
+    assert root.parent is None
+    assert child.parent is root
+    assert sibling.parent is root
+    assert leaf.parent is child
+
+    assert child.path is child.relative_path
+    assert leaf.schema_path is leaf.relative_schema_path
+    assert list(root.path) == ["payload", 2]
+    assert list(root.schema_path) == ["properties", "payload", "items", "anyOf"]
+    assert list(child.path) == ["branch"]
+    assert list(child.schema_path) == [0, "oneOf"]
+    assert list(sibling.path) == [4]
+    assert list(sibling.schema_path) == [1, "type"]
+    assert list(leaf.path) == ["bad-name", 1]
+    assert list(leaf.schema_path) == [
+        0, "properties", "bad-name", "items", "type",
+    ]
+
+    assert list(child.absolute_path) == ["payload", 2, "branch"]
+    assert list(sibling.absolute_path) == ["payload", 2, 4]
+    assert list(leaf.absolute_path) == [
+        "payload", 2, "branch", "bad-name", 1,
+    ]
+    assert list(child.absolute_schema_path) == [
+        "properties", "payload", "items", "anyOf", 0, "oneOf",
+    ]
+    assert list(sibling.absolute_schema_path) == [
+        "properties", "payload", "items", "anyOf", 1, "type",
+    ]
+    assert list(leaf.absolute_schema_path) == [
+        "properties", "payload", "items", "anyOf", 0, "oneOf",
+        0, "properties", "bad-name", "items", "type",
+    ]
+    assert root.json_path == "$.payload[2]"
+    assert child.json_path == "$.payload[2].branch"
+    assert sibling.json_path == "$.payload[2][4]"
+    assert leaf.json_path == "$.payload[2].branch['bad-name'][1]"
+
+    if isinstance(children, SinglePass):
+        assert children.iterations == 1
+        assert nested.iterations == 1
+
+
+def test_empty_generator_context():
+    error = ValidationError("empty", context=as_generator([]))
+    assert error.context == []
+    assert error.parent is None
+    assert error.json_path == "$"

spec.question: Constructing a `ValidationError` with generator-valued `context` retains the children, but their absolute locations differ from those produced with list-valued context. Make finite single-pass context iterables behave like lists: preserve child identity and order, retain relative instance and schema paths, and keep nested contexts intact. Each immediate child must have the aggregate as its parent, so children and grandchildren report the correct `absolute_path`, `absolute_schema_path`, and `json_path` even when the aggregate has nonempty instance and schema paths. Consume the supplied iterable only once, including when it is empty, and preserve existing list-valued behavior. Return a unified diff against production files only; do not change keyword handlers or tests.
